outer_fold_policy: Reuse the five saved T0 outer folds so every T1 validation candidate receives a T0 prior generated without that candidate.
excluded_duplicate_prior: priority_t0 equals p_review_warranted_t0 and is retained only as audit metadata.
model_selection_policy: Choose lower nested-OOF calibrated log loss. If the difference is less than 0.01, prefer multinomial logistic regression unless CatBoost improves macro-F1 by at least 0.02.

review_priority.reason: Keep T0 and T1 operational ranking transparent and comparable.
